messages:
Maya: Heads up — migration job 2026-09-rbac-backfill ran at 01:10 and created a handful of role rows with tenant_id=NULL. We just saw a client service fetch that resolved to project-level 'read' instead of service principal deny. Investigating.

Samir: @Maya can you paste the query? I want to see the WHERE clause that set tenant_id.

Maya: Here — backfill used:
```
INSERT INTO role_assignments(role_id, principal_id, tenant_id, created_at)
SELECT r.id, p.id, p.default_tenant, now() FROM principals p JOIN roles r ON r.name='readonly'
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL;
```
but default_tenant is NULL for some legacy service accounts.

Elena: Ah — so NULL persisted and migration code treats NULL as global ownership. That maps to 'org_read' role and elevated scope.

Tony: Can we quick-fix by running an UPDATE to set tenant_id = p.fallback_tenant WHERE tenant_id IS NULL? Any idea how many rows?

Maya: ~68 rows across prod-primary and prod-rr. Query to count: `select count(*) from role_assignments where tenant_id is null;` — returns 68. I don't want to run blind update without signoff.

Samir: We need a rollback plan. Option A: delete the rows and rerun backfill with coalesce(default_tenant, fallback_tenant). Option B: patch the service code to treat NULL as no-access (safer) until backfill fixed. Which is lower blast radius?

Elena: Patch service to deny on NULL is fastest and reversible. We can also add audit log tag so we can find affected principals.

Maya: I'll PR the patch now — will add a feature flag `rbac_null_tenant_deny=true` and add an audit tag `migration-2026-09-null-tenant`.

Tony: Can we schedule a canary on prod-dedicated region first? We'll flip flag for 10% traffic then 100% after 5m.

Samir: Also check KMS keys — some service principals rely on DB role to access KMS-wrapped creds. If we deny them they may cause token refresh errors. Need to alert SSO infra + oncall.

Maya: Noted. Pinged @ops-eng and @security-bot to create incident ticket and add to oncall runbook.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-524 — RBAC backfill null-tenant. Severity: P2. Channels: eng-security, oncall-ops. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rbac-backfill-null

Elena: After patch and canary, we'll delete the 68 rows and rerun backfill with `coalesce(p.default_tenant, p.fallback_tenant)`. We'll keep audit logs for 30d.

Tony: Postmortem owners? @Maya and @Samir? Also need a release note and customer-facing blurb if any tenants were impacted.

Maya: I'll own postmortem and we should include model requests that used the elevated access. I'll export access logs via `select * from audit_events where tag='migration-2026-09-null-tenant'`.

Samir: Thanks. Action items: Maya — PR + canary flip; Tony — coord with oncall and KMS team; Elena — prepare backfill rerun w/ coalesce; Ops — monitor errors and rollback if >1% error increase.

Maya: PR opened — https://gh.redwood/repo/pulls/4091 — deploying to canary shortly :rocket:

Tony: :thumbsup:
